g.text: deployment_replicas active -> failed; deployments degraded or failed
clusters of the node (status ready or degraded)
per cluster: nodeIsLive? (active, last_seen within 2 min)
live: member status running, settleClusterStatus (reinstate, stop here)
cluster of size 1: member failed, cluster degraded, ErrEvalClusterNoReplacement, stop
dead: member status failed, cluster degraded
guardRaftRemoval, then remove the dead raft address through a survivor (Admin Remove)
spawn rqlite follower (-join a survivor), olric, gateway, per dead role
insert membership rows only for spawns that succeeded
removeAndEvictMember: owed teardown row, delete membership, evict allocations
status ready only if no spawn error; else stays degraded
